verdict.rationale: The only mobile-specific evidence is that Reflect's iOS app has a lock screen widget for one-tap audio memo capture, which shows an iOS app with some capture ability. Search, linking, and backlinks are documented, but nothing ties them to the mobile apps. Missing for 10: any evidence of an Android app, documentation that mobile apps offer full search and bidirectional linking, evidence the mobile apps match desktop rather than acting as a companion, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile functionality.
